candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (fast, ~1ms), causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Payment logs show repeated 503s including on /readyz, indicating payment is unavailable/unhealthy rather than slow.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record only shows payment v1.0.0 baseline; it does not establish deployment-caused failure. Root trigger inside payment is unknown.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s originating from order, which fails because payment returns 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory reservations succeed. Payment logs confirm repeated 503s including /readyz. Bounded candidate: payment unavailability (http-500 class) propagating to gateway 502. Deployment record alone does not establish causation.
